title: An all-input event kernel reports relative certificates for retrospective reaction inference
status_authority: Selected source bytes and producer-reported internal reviews are preserved. This integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority or practical advantage.
reported_status: The completed P3 return reports an unnormalized reaction-event kernel with an entrywise relative certificate for every initial joint law, plus a retrospective finite inference application. The captured proof, code and data were not executed or independently audited in this integration.
scientific_scope_status: For the source finite-local-module and one-opening controller contract, the reported unnormalized kernel can be applied after choosing an initial joint distribution, including a correlated entrance, and its relative certificate covers every supplied initial joint law. A binary numerical bridge is narrower than the stated general finite-block proof. The return reports an example where conditioning on a later identified event changes an earlier hidden-count posterior.
